name: windflow
description: Evidence-led development with investigation, parent-led decisions, independent proposals, and verified delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Understand first. Design deliberately. Verify the result.
interface.longDescription: The parent owns investigation synthesis, requirement interviews, design convergence, and delivery. Independent agents investigate, propose alternatives, implement, and discover defects. Includes eight bundled capabilities, evidence-based finding verification, and requirement, ticket, and merge checkpoints.
defaultPrompt: Use $windflow to investigate this request, agree on the behavior, compare designs, and deliver verified changes. Wait for my ticket-breakdown and final merge confirmations.
